correctness.rationale: For L with n smooth circle components and s extra finite point punctures, Alexander duality in S^3 removes L, Q and infinity, so cohomology is Z in degree zero, Z^n degree one, Z^(n+s) degree two, zero above. Excision and local orientation at s punctures split old H^2 classes from s small-sphere generators. In the Fadell–Neuwirth fibration forgetting the kth point, last-coordinate pullbacks of integral H^1/H^2(M_L) and global Gauss maps g_ik to S^2 produce fiberwise integral additive bases, since each g_ik has degree +1 on one puncture sphere and zero on the others. Integral Leray–Hirsch multiplies the Poincare polynomial by 1+nt+(n+k-1)t^2 for each k, proving torsion-freeness for every smooth link/k. For n=1,k=2 it expands to 1+2t+4t^2+3t^3+2t^4. Removing codimension-three diagonals preserves pi1, so unknot complement has abelian Z^k and trefoil complement has nonabelian direct-power group (surjects to S3); same additive cohomology does not force homotopy equivalence.
